The only open keeper-style function on Hyperlane's arbitrum stack is Mailbox.process(bytes,bytes): anyone can call it (no access modifier; replaying real calldata from a fresh address reverts only with 'Mailbox: already delivered', not a role error) but it pays the caller 0 on-chain - it forwards msg.value to the recipient's handle() and only records deliveries[id].processor, so relayers are compensated off-chain. Everything else on the stack is onlyOwner (setDefaultHook/setDefaultIsm/setRequiredHook), a whitelist (MovableCollateralRouter.rebalance = onlyRebalancer, one route only) or caller-pays (dispatch x3, transferRemote); ProtocolFee.claimProtocolFeesForValidator(address) pays the validator argument and reverts from a fresh address. No Fast* warp route on arbitrum, so there is no fast-fill fee stream either.
